confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge and the city context; no live booking pages, menus, or current listings were checked. Restaurant and cafe anchors are moderate confidence. Accommodation anchors, especially the hostel and 3-star figures, are lower confidence and assume Colombian IVA (19%) is included. Cocktail and wine are estimated from the local beer relationship (bar drinks roughly 2.5 to 3 times draft beer), not from direct price knowledge. FX caveat: I could not confirm an RBA observation for the generation date (2026-10-16). The RBA exchange-rates page in search results showed 2026-03-20 as its latest entry, which is the observation reported here. A third-party site cited 0.6947 for 2026-10-16 as RBA data, but I could not verify it against rba.gov.au, so it is not used. Re-check the F11 table before relying on the conversion.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on general knowledge of price levels in mid-sized and capital Latin American cities with similar tourist demand (for example Medellin, Lima, and lower-cost districts of Mexico City), adjusted to Bogota's Colombian peso pricing at roughly 4,000 COP per USD.
